text:
zoe: we have a customer hitting weird SSE behavior from the API this morning — long-running stream, then client sees a partial JSON chunk and socket closes. they say it happens ~30-60s into the stream, same client reproducer across regions. throwing `ECONNRESET` on frontend. can we triage?

ana: ack, collecting details. customer id: acct_78xx, endpoint: /v1/streams/generate, model: redwood-large-8k, mode: streaming. attached client stack is node fetch + eventsource polyfill. they say this started after a gateway upgrade yesterday. :thinking_face: 

devon: can you paste the minimal repro? curious if it's a protocol framing issue or a mid-stream drop. also, does the client get a final Content-Length or chunk-close? SSE should be chunked until `data: [DONE]` and then connection closed.

zoe: here's the simplified repro they sent:

```
const EventSource = require('eventsource');
const es = new EventSource('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/generate?model=redwood-large-8k', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer X' }});
es.onmessage = (e) => console.log('MSG', e.data);
es.onerror = (err) => console.log('ERR', err);
```

Customer says logs show the SSE stream ends mid-JSON like `{"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hel` and then socket resets.

devon: interesting. two possibilities: 1) upstream runtime killed the worker (OOM/eviction) and TCP reset propagated; 2) an intermediary (proxy/load-balancer/CDN) timed out idle connection and injected a RST. we need to differentiate. can you share the raw tcpdump or proxy logs?

ana: customer pasted proxy logs (truncated):
```
2026-11-03T10:12:14Z PROXY connection idle 65s -> closing
2026-11-03T10:12:14Z PROXY FIN sent
```
They also included runtime logs: no obvious OOMs, but a worker recycle around the same time with message `worker: evicting idle-task`.

ivan: both signals present. proxy closing at 65s is suspicious — our proxies default idle timeout is 60s but we had a config push yesterday that accidentally set `idle_timeout=65s` for the edge pool. if proxy closes at >60s it will RST the client. also note some client polyfills don't auto-reconnect on 5xx vs ECONNRESET.

devon: for design discussion: we currently rely on TCP keepalives + proxy idle timers. that leaves a 30–90s window where partial events can be lost without an application-level liveness marker. we should consider adding an optional periodic SSE comment frame (`:ping\n\n`) every 15s to keep connections alive and make midstream drops explicit to clients. also, make sure proxy honors `connection: keep-alive` semantics.

ana: quick mitigation for customer: 1) set their client to auto-reconnect on error and resume with `?resume_after=last_event_id` if available; 2) increase edge proxy idle timeout for that routing rule to 120s while we investigate; 3) advise using native SSE support where possible (EventSource) vs fragile polyfills. communicated to customer and will apply proxy change during low traffic window.

devon: can we add a config flag in runtime to emit `:probe` comment frames as an opt-in per-deployment? devex wants opt-in so we don't change semantics for everyone. Pseudocode on server: 
```
if (config.sse_probe_interval) {
  setInterval(() => {
    socket.write(':probe\\n\\n');
  }, config.sse_probe_interval);
}
```
This keeps connection alive and is SSE-compliant (comment lines are ignored by EventSource but are activity).

ivan: +1. also recommend enabling TCP keepalive on worker sockets and adjusting kernel keepalive_time to 30s in dedicated and private deployments. for hosted, we should tune proxy idle to align with common model latencies.

sre-bot: AUTO: created incident INC-20261103-17 for "SSE partial frames + proxy idle mismatch" and assigned to eng-runtime.

devon: next actions:
- eng-runtime: prototype `sse_probe_interval` flag and document behavior (devon)
- eng-sre: audit recent config pushes to edge pool and revert accidental 65s setting (ivan)
- support: roll out temporary routing rule with 120s idle timeout and share repro steps with customer (ana)
- docs: add guidance on robust SSE clients (reconnect logic, last-event-id resume) and mention comment ping approach (devex)

ana: i've scheduled the proxy revert for 11/03 23:00 UTC and notified the customer of the mitigation. Customer confirmed temporary fix reduces disconnects, but wants durable solution (probe + keepalive).

zoe: thanks team — customer is happy for now. will follow up after runtime patch. :thumbsup:

devon: long-term, let's also add a small test harness that runs a 2-minute SSE connection under middlebox conditions (idle close at 60s, RST behavior) to catch regressions. I'll open a PR with tests and a draft runtime patch.

ivan: logging note: if we see partial JSON frames, we should log `partial_frame=true` in request traces to make postmortems easier. small change but very helpful.

ana: closing loop — updating thread when PR lands or if any further customer impacts.
